d:
Build stronger legs, improve muscular endurance, and get a serious lower-body workout in just 15 minutes — no equipment needed.
This 15-minute military-style leg workout uses bodyweight exercises to target your quads, hamstrings, glutes, and calves while building the strength and endurance you need to perform.
WORKOUT: 15 Minutes
FORMAT: 40 Sec Work / 20 Sec Rest
EQUIPMENT: None
FOCUS: Legs, Glutes, Strength & Muscular Endurance
